description: A fictional harpoon launcher game prop for a cave hunter, chunky low-poly, held level with the harpoon point forward. One long octagonal sand-grey painted barrel tube with wide chamfers, a thick dark steel muzzle rim at its front end and two wide charcoal bands around it, one behind the muzzle rim and one in the middle. Under the front of the tube, hung on a short sand-grey bracket, one wide line spool drum about 0.12 m across whose axis runs left to right: two thick octagonal dark steel side rims around a solid fat charcoal winding; on its left face one fat charcoal crank: a round hub, a short thick arm and a fat round knob pointing forward. Behind the spool under the tube one squared charcoal trigger guard with a thick trigger and one chunky charcoal pistol grip raked back with big diagonal ribs; above the grip on the left flank one raised sand-grey plate carrying one small rectangular teal lamp window in a thick raised charcoal bezel. At the rear one sand-grey stock frame of two thick bars around a recessed dark charcoal triangular panel, ending in a fat tall charcoal butt pad.
proportions: Out of the muzzle sticks one thick dark steel harpoon bolt about 0.18 m long with an arrow point and exactly two fat swept-back barbs. About 0.95 m long, 0.14 m wide and 0.30 m tall. (length : width : height = 1.29 : 1 : 2.14)
sides: on the LEFT flank only: the crank on the spool's left face (hub, arm, knob, sticking out past the spool) and the raised lamp plate with the teal lamp window above the grip. The right flank is plain: smooth sand tube and stock, a plain spool rim face. The tube, the harpoon bolt and its two barbs, the spool drum, the bracket, the trigger guard, the grip, the stock and the butt pad are on the centre line.
